text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today's the last day of summer camp, huh. 
I guess I feel pretty decent about how it 
went.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once summer ends, autumn will arrive. And 
when it does—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. And there, with her—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...We still have time before the main 
event. Let's make sure we address the 
issues that came up this time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't just hand the number one spot over 
to her!
